'''Ukadan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Specialist/Legends|specialist]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at the [[South Tram Station]] in the [[Axial Park]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], distributing [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and medical supplies to other Imperial forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Specialist Ukadan appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Stims Vendor for Imperial players on Corellia.<ref name="TOR" />
